summary:
### Gemilang Mega Systems Sdn. Bhd.
Active private limited technology company incorporated on 14 December 1994 in Pulau Pinang, specializing in software development for small business accounting. Share capital is RM100,000. It has two directors, who are also its shareholders, holding 55.65% and 44.35%, respectively.

Revenue rose from RM205.13 million in FY2022 to RM266.01 million in FY2024. After losses of RM27.12 million in FY2022 and RM7.42 million in FY2023, the company returned to profitability in FY2024, recording PAT of RM16.81 million. FY2024 operating cash flow was RM23.99 million and total assets were RM256.58 million. Total liabilities were RM139.84 million, borrowings RM52.97 million and equity RM116.73 million. It had positive working capital, a quick ratio of 1.35 and cash ratio of 0.18. Free cash flow was RM9.85 million and interest coverage was 8.59. Audit opinions were unqualified for all three years. No litigation cases are recorded.

### Jaya Prima Travel Sdn. Bhd.
Active private limited hospitality company incorporated on 1 April 1995 in Kuala Lumpur, operating a travel agency specializing in umrah and inbound tourism. Share capital is RM2.5 million. It has four directors and three shareholders holding 47.38%, 34.78% and 17.84%.

Revenue declined from RM49.47 million in FY2022 to RM43.29 million in FY2024. Losses increased over the period, with FY2024 PAT of negative RM7.52 million and operating loss of RM6.69 million. Operating cash flow was negative in each year, reaching negative RM5.94 million in FY2024. Total assets were RM62.66 million, liabilities RM45.08 million, borrowings RM14.98 million and equity RM17.58 million. Current assets of RM17.73 million were below current liabilities of RM21.96 million, resulting in negative working capital of RM4.23 million. The quick ratio was 0.55 and interest coverage was negative 8.13. Audit opinions were unqualified for all three years. No litigation cases are recorded.

### Cahaya Golden Systems Sdn. Bhd.
Technology company incorporated on 29 September 2019 in Selangor, specializing in software development for small business accounting. Its recorded status is Winding up. Share capital is RM2.5 million; it has three directors and three shareholders holding 52.17%, 32.40% and 15.43%.

Revenue was RM13.01 million in FY2024. The company remained profitable across FY2022–FY2024, with FY2024 PAT of RM1.28 million and operating cash flow of RM1.33 million. FY2024 total assets were RM15.39 million, liabilities RM5.75 million, equity RM9.63 million and borrowings RM4.35 million. The quick ratio was 1.62 and cash ratio 0.79; free cash flow was approximately RM615,000.

It has eight recorded litigation cases, including pending breach-of-contract and debt-recovery matters, a pending winding-up petition and a winding-up petition with judgment entered. Other cases are recorded as dismissed, withdrawn or settled. FY2022 audit opinion was unqualified with material uncertainty on going concern; FY2023 and FY2024 opinions were unqualified.

### Cahaya Seri Catering Sdn. Bhd.
Active private limited food and beverage company incorporated on 20 November 2017 in Sabah, distributing frozen food to restaurants. Share capital is RM500,000. It has three directors and two shareholders, holding 98.86% and 1.14%.

Revenue was RM4.42 million in FY2024 and PAT was RM179,000. Operating cash flow declined to RM220,000 in FY2024. Total assets were RM4.77 million, liabilities RM2.82 million, equity RM1.95 million and borrowings RM2.13 million. Current assets of RM2.04 million exceeded current liabilities of RM1.08 million. The quick ratio was 1.40 and cash ratio 0.28; free cash flow was slightly negative (approximately RM20,000).

Six litigation cases are recorded, including debt recovery, construction, employment, winding-up petition and tenancy matters. One winding-up petition remains pending; other matters are recorded as settled, dismissed or judgment entered. Audit opinions for FY2022 and FY2024 were unqualified.

### Delima Pacific Academy Sdn. Bhd.
Active private limited education company incorporated on 5 June 1991 in Kuala Lumpur, providing professional training courses in accounting and finance. Share capital is RM250,000. It has two directors and two shareholders holding 42.58% and 57.42%.

Revenue was RM27.55 million in FY2024. The company remained profitable in each of FY2022–FY2024, with FY2024 PAT of RM1.87 million and operating cash flow of RM3.79 million. Total assets were RM19.23 million, liabilities RM9.72 million, equity RM9.52 million and borrowings RM6.45 million. It had positive working capital, a quick ratio of 1.80 and cash ratio of 0.28. Free cash flow was approximately RM2.03 million and interest coverage 7.92. Audit opinions were unqualified for all three years. No litigation cases are recorded.

### Teguh Kirana Freight Sdn. Bhd.
Active private limited logistics company incorporated on 6 September 1992 in Pulau Pinang, with a recorded business involving last-mile parcel delivery across Kuching. Share capital is RM2.5 million. It has five directors and two shareholders, holding 98.34% and 1.66%.

Revenue grew to RM21.52 million in FY2024 and PAT was RM914,000. Operating cash flow was positive at RM1.53 million. FY2024 total assets were RM21.67 million, liabilities RM13.39 million, equity RM8.28 million and borrowings RM2.95 million. Liquidity tightened in FY2024, with quick ratio 0.99 and cash ratio 0.23. Free cash flow was RM508,000 and interest coverage 8.41.

One debt-recovery case is recorded, in which the company was plaintiff; the case was filed in September 2024 at the Sessions Court in Pulau Pinang and settled. Audit opinions were unqualified for all three years.

### Mutiara Delima Bakery Sdn. Bhd.
Active private limited food and beverage company incorporated on 28 August 1995 in Kuala Lumpur, recorded as operating coffee shops and cafés in Penang. Share capital is RM500,000. It has five directors and four shareholders holding 50.59%, 25.88%, 13.39% and 10.14%. It was formerly Gemilang Ventures Sdn. Bhd., with the name change recorded on 27 November 2025.

Revenue declined to RM2.08 million in FY2024, and the company recorded losses throughout the period, with FY2024 PAT of negative RM276,000 and operating cash flow of negative RM139,000. Total assets were RM1.96 million, liabilities RM1.97 million, equity negative RM18,500 and borrowings RM787,000. Current liabilities exceeded current assets, giving negative working capital of approximately RM17,700. The quick ratio was 0.63, cash ratio 0.13 and free cash flow negative RM206,000; interest coverage was negative 5.37.

Two litigation cases are recorded: a defendant debt-recovery case dismissed in September 2025 and a plaintiff debt-recovery case settled in June 2021. Audit opinions were unqualified for all three years.

### Seri Everbright Klinik Sdn. Bhd.
Active private limited healthcare company incorporated on 3 December 1995 in Kedah. Its recorded business description is home-based elderly care services. Share capital is RM5 million. It has two directors and one shareholder, who holds 100%.

Revenue reached RM57.99 million in FY2024. After losses in FY2022 and FY2023, the company returned to profitability in FY2024, recording PAT of RM3.85 million and operating cash flow of RM6.12 million. Total assets were RM68.97 million, liabilities RM29.46 million, equity RM39.51 million and borrowings RM7.80 million. It had positive working capital, quick ratio 1.21 and cash ratio 0.36. Free cash flow was RM3.88 million and interest coverage 12.81.

One debt-recovery litigation case is recorded, in which the company was plaintiff; the case was filed in November 2022 at the Sessions Court in Kedah and dismissed. Audit opinions were unqualified for all three years.

### Sinar Everbright Trading Sdn. Bhd.
Active private limited retail company incorporated on 29 December 2007 in Kuala Lumpur, operating an online retail business selling baby products and toys. Share capital is RM100,000. It has five directors and four shareholders holding 72.70%, 16.81%, 10.35% and 0.14%.

Revenue declined to RM1.12 million in FY2024 and PAT fell to RM3,710, leaving a very narrow profit margin. Operating cash flow was RM16,385. Total assets were RM1.69 million, liabilities RM417,000, equity RM1.27 million and borrowings RM255,000. It had positive working capital, quick ratio 1.39 and cash ratio 0.70, but free cash flow was negative RM34,000 and interest coverage was 1.35.

All three years had unqualified audit opinions. No litigation cases are recorded.

### Mutiara Delima Agro Sdn. Bhd.
Active private limited agriculture company incorporated on 11 April 2023 in Kuala Lumpur, operating an oil palm plantation and supplying fresh fruit bunches. Share capital is RM250,000. It has four directors and three shareholders holding 58.92%, 24.20% and 16.88%. It was formerly Sejahtera Resources Sdn. Bhd., with the name change recorded on 27 November 2023.

FY2024 revenue was RM74.30 million, but the company recorded PAT of negative RM3.66 million, operating loss of RM2.53 million and negative operating cash flow of RM1.58 million. Total assets were RM101.34 million, liabilities RM35.27 million, equity RM66.07 million and borrowings RM20.46 million. It maintained positive working capital, with current assets of RM52.18 million and current liabilities of RM18.01 million. Quick ratio was 1.99 and cash ratio 0.59, but free cash flow was negative RM6.64 million and interest coverage negative 2.25.

No litigation cases are recorded. FY2024 audit opinion was unqualified.
